newsitem.title: CHINA: China said drafting rules on brokerage activities.
newsitem.headline: China said drafting rules on brokerage activities.

text.p: China's top market watchdog is formulating rules to tighten supervision over the brokerage activities of securities firms, the official China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

The China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) is drafting the rules due to problems with the brokerage industry, including misappropriation of customers' funds, poor service and violations of market regulations, the newspaper said.
The rules, the first aimed specifically at brokerage activities, would be based on existing guidelines, it said, quoting a CSRC official.
The newspaper did not say when the new rules would go into effect.
Under the rules, brokers would be required to provide quality service and guarantee the safety of the funds of customers, the newspaper said.
